speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I need to understand the nature of the skin lesions you are concerned about. Can you describe exactly what you see on your skin, including their color, size, shape, and how long they have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit.

I have noted your history as a 62-year-old male smoker from Africa with non-healing, crusty lesions on the penis shaft and left middle finger, and previous ineffective treatments for syphilis and eczema. Given the chronic nature and location of these lesions, I need to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile lesion and left middle finger lesion. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of lesions.
